deficits.evidence: No footway visible on the left side of the road, pedestrians walking in the carriageway
deficits.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Informal path on the right side is partly blocked by market stalls and goods
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the informal path on the right side to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the informal path on the right side
deficits.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path on the right side to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: No crossing facility visible despite high pedestrian demand
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Insufficient street lighting along the urban road
deficits.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both pedestrians and drivers.

ratings.reason: The left side of the road is not clearly visible in the frames, so the absence of a footway cannot be confirmed.
The frames clearly show market stalls and goods obstructing the pedestrian area on the right side of the road.
The surface quality of the informal path on the right is not clear enough to confirm trip hazards.
No marked pedestrian crossing is visible in any of the frames, despite the high volume of pedestrians.
The frames are taken during the day, so the adequacy of street lighting for nighttime use cannot be assessed.
